held_out_already_read.reason: held-out rows already read by version 1: design version 2 grades rows of split strength-split-v1 (cutoff 2026-01-01) that design version 1 already graded and published (through 2026-04-30), and its changes were chosen after those numbers were read. Its numbers are PROVISIONAL, not fresh held-out accuracy: no marker verdict and no headline accuracy claim is made on them. Fresh held-out rows need a split whose cutoff is after 2026-04-30.

test.note: rows counts those whose trust or strength model was fitted on labels of their own search group or their own site. Trust is split by search and site: training and validation rows take trust models fitted without their search fold and site fold, test rows the trust model fitted on training searches and training sites only, so trust_own_site_in_fit is 0. Strength is split by search only: training and validation rows take a strength score fitted without their search fold but WITH their own site's pages on other searches (later ones too), and test rows the main score, fitted on training pages before the cutoff that hold held-out sites on training searches; strength_own_site_in_fit counts them. later_labels counts rows whose models learned from pages dated after the row's forecast date (none for test rows).

Trust is split by search and site: training and validation rows take trust models fitted without their search fold and site fold, test rows the trust model fitted on training searches and training sites only, so trust_own_site_in_fit is 0. Strength is split by search only: training and validation rows take a strength score fitted without their search fold but WITH their own site's pages on other searches (later ones too), and test rows the main score, fitted on training pages before the cutoff that hold held-out sites on training searches; strength_own_site_in_fit counts them. later_labels counts rows whose models learned from pages dated after the row's forecast date (none for test rows).

slice.rule: rows whose outcome date is in the last 90 days before the end of the training period; fewer than 2000 rows falls back to every row

model_inputs.main_score_sites_from: the sites on the training page rows of the split in force (strength_training_rows), the rows the main score's procedure is fitted on
model_inputs.scheme: training and validation rows: strength from the score fitted without their search fold (their own site's pages on other searches are in it), trust from the model fitted without their search fold and their site fold; test rows: the main models (the main strength score's training pages hold held-out sites on training searches)

notes: The panel cannot give searches a site targets but never ranks for. Every cell exists because the site appeared on the search at least once. An upload-day forecast for a brand-new site, which is mostly not in the top 50, cannot be validated on it.
CONDITIONAL on the site appearing on the page. Cells that never appear are missing, so this is not the upload-day hit rate.
Persistence equals always NT50 here: an entrant was not on the input page.
Page middle and always 21 to 50 score the same under rule v1 whenever the page middle is 21 to 50.
48 brand searches (the search contains the site's brand name) are left out of the headline and shown apart.
Backtest labels are single snapshots (one country-level page each), not clean readings.
